title: IT Support Associate
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**

Provide responsive Level 1 IT support to employees in India and other supported locations. The role owns the user experience from first contact through resolution or escalation, supports secure endpoint and account operations, and keeps service records accurate and current.

**Position Overview**

Job title

IT Support Associate (L1)

  

Experience

2-3 years in service desk, desktop support, or end-user computing

  

Education

Bachelor’s degree (BE, B.Tech, BCA, BSc IT/Computer Science) or a 3-year full-time technical diploma; equivalent relevant experience may be considered

  

Location

Gurugram / Delhi NCR

  

Work model

Hybrid, with regular on-site support as business needs require

  

Reporting to

IT Manager

  

Schedule

Ability to support assigned business hours and participate in planned after-hours work or an on-call rotation, if required

  

Certifications

Preferred, not mandatory: ITIL Foundation, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals (MS-900), CompTIA A+, or a relevant endpoint-support certification

**What You Will Do**

**Service Desk & User Support**

* Act as the first point of contact for technical assistance through the approved ticketing channels, remote support, and in-person support.

* Log, categorize, prioritize, and update incidents and service requests with clear troubleshooting notes and the correct resolution or escalation path.

* Diagnose and resolve common hardware, software, connectivity, access, and collaboration-tool issues using structured questioning and documented procedures.

* Own tickets through closure, keep users informed, and escalate complex, high-impact, security-related, or ageing issues to the appropriate team.

* Work within defined service targets and proactively raise SLA or user-impact risks to the IT Manager.

**Endpoint & Identity Operations**

* Prepare, configure, deploy, collect, and refresh Windows and macOS endpoints, mobile devices, and standard peripherals.

* Perform approved user lifecycle tasks in Microsoft Entra ID and related systems, including account updates, group or license requests, password support, and MFA reset, following access-control procedures.

* Support endpoint management and security controls through Microsoft Intune and/or JAMF, including enrolment, policy compliance, encryption checks, patching coordination, and standard application deployment.

* Troubleshoot basic office network, Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and TCP/IP issues; escalate infrastructure issues with complete diagnostics.

* Support onboarding, transfers, and offboarding by completing assigned tasks accurately and within agreed timelines.

**Software, Collaboration Tools & Security**

* Install, configure, and troubleshoot approved business applications and Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive.

* Provide basic support for approved AI productivity tools, focusing on access, client configuration, and user guidance within company policy; escalating privacy, security, or data-handling concerns.

* Recognize and promptly escalate suspected phishing, malware, data-loss, or other security events; do not independently administer email security controls unless specifically authorized.

* Assist senior team members with pilots, rollouts, endpoint changes, and user communications for new tools or processes.

**Asset Records, Knowledge & Continuous Improvement**

* Complete assigned asset-management activities such as tagging, stock checks, assignment and return records, and reconciliation of device and software data under the direction of the process owner.

* Create or update ticket notes, knowledge articles, FAQs, and work instructions using approved templates; obtain review for new or materially changed procedures.

* Identify recurring issues, knowledge gaps, and opportunities to improve employee support experience.

* Collaborate with regional and global IT teams and external support partners to resolve issues and deliver a consistent service.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* 2-3 years of hands-on experience in an IT service desk, desktop support, or end-user computing role.

* Practical support experience with Windows and macOS devices, common peripherals, and remote-support tools.

* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, endpoint management concepts, and account or access support.

* Experience using an ITSM platform such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Freshservice, or a comparable tool.

* Foundational knowledge of endpoint security, phishing awareness, encryption, patching, MFA, and least-privilege practices.

* Clear written and spoken English, professional user communication, and the ability to explain technical steps in simple terms.

* Strong troubleshooting, prioritization, follow-through, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting a hybrid workforce and collaborating with distributed or global IT teams.

* Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Intune and/or JAMF.

* Basic familiarity with approved AI productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or Claude.

* Basic Linux awareness is helpful only where the supported environment requires it; it is not a core requirement for this role.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

Performance will be assessed against the team’s established service targets and operating procedures, with emphasis on:

* Timely response, accurate prioritization, and appropriate escalation of support requests.

* Quality and completeness of ticket notes, asset records, and knowledge updates.

* Reliable completion of onboarding, offboarding, endpoint, and access-related tasks.

* Positive, professional user communication and consistent ownership through resolution.

* Adherence to security, privacy, access control, and change management requirements.

* Contribution to team learning, recurring-issue reduction, and service improvement.

**Why Work for Material?**

In addition to fulfilling, high-impact work, company culture and benefits are integral to determining whether a role is the right fit. Here is a little about who we are and what we value.

**Who We Are & What We Care About**

* Material is a global company that works with leading brands worldwide. We also create and launch new brands and products, placing innovation and value creation at the center of our practice.

* Our clients span organizations across technology, retail, transportation, finance, and healthcare. Employees collaborate with talented colleagues across the company, the country, and the world.

* We prize inclusion and interconnectedness. We amplify our impact through the people, perspectives, and expertise we engage in our work.

* We are a learning-oriented, outcomes-focused community that creates experiences that matter, generates new value, and makes a difference in people’s lives.

**CANDIDATE NOTE**

Candidates who meet most, but not every, preferred qualification are encouraged to apply.

title: IT Help Desk & Support Specialist
description:
**Job Title:** IT Help Desk & Support Specialist  
**Location:** Gurugram, India  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 5–6 Years  
**Department:** IT & Infrastructure

**About Us**

The Knowledge Center (KC), Gurgaon is a state-of-the-art material experience and innovation hub serving the architecture, design, and construction industry. We rely on robust IT infrastructure, secure systems, and seamless connectivity to support our day-to-day operations.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on **IT Help Desk & Support Specialist** who can independently manage the company's IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, domain services, email systems, cybersecurity, hardware, software, and end-user devices. We need an all-round IT professional who can **diagnose, troubleshoot, configure, maintain, and resolve technical issues independently**, rather than simply raising and closing support tickets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Network & Server Management:** Configure and troubleshoot LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, VPN, domain servers, and server connectivity.
* **Domain & Directory Services:** Manage domain joining, user accounts, permissions, Group Policy, LDAP, Active Directory, and device authentication.
* **Windows & macOS Support:** Diagnose and resolve OS, application, driver, connectivity, performance, and system configuration issues.
* **Email & Mail Server:** Manage business email accounts, mail configuration, synchronization, access issues, and troubleshooting of email delivery and server-related problems.
* **Antivirus & IT Security:** Manage antivirus/endpoint protection, security updates, access controls, system patching, and basic security incident troubleshooting.
* **Mobile & Tablet Configuration:** Configure smartphones and tablets for company email, domain-related access, LDAP/directory authentication where supported, and device synchronization.
* **Hardware & Software Support:** Install, configure, upgrade, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, peripherals, operating systems, and business applications.
* **System Synchronization & Access:** Troubleshoot file sharing, network drives, user profiles, cloud or local synchronization, permissions, and cross-device access.
* **Biometric & Access Systems:** Configure and maintain biometric attendance devices, user enrolment, connectivity, data synchronization, and related software.
* **IT Asset & Infrastructure Management:** Maintain hardware/software inventories, licences, backups, IT documentation, preventive maintenance, and vendor coordination.
* **Hands-on Technical Support:** Identify root causes, implement permanent fixes, manage escalations when necessary, and ensure minimal downtime across the organization.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate/Diploma in IT, Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking, or a related field.
* **5–6 years of hands-on experience** in IT support, network administration, server management, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Strong practical knowledge of **Windows, macOS, networking, IP configuration, domain servers, Active Directory, LDAP, DNS, DHCP, and email systems**.
* Experience with antivirus/endpoint security, hardware and software troubleshooting, mobile/tablet configuration, system synchronization, and biometric devices.
* Ability to independently diagnose technical issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, documentation, and user-support skills.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

A proactive, technically strong IT professional who can take ownership of the organization's IT environment, manage day-to-day infrastructure, and resolve complex technical issues independently. Practical troubleshooting ability is essential; ticket management alone is not sufficient.

**Keywords**

IT Help Desk, IT Support, IT Infrastructure, Network Administration, Server Management, Domain Server, Active Directory, LDAP, Windows Troubleshooting, macOS Support, Mail Server, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, Antivirus, Endpoint Security, Hardware Troubleshooting, Software Installation, Mobile Device Configuration, System Synchronization, Biometric Systems, IT Asset Management, Backup, IT Security, Technical Support.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: IT Global Service Desk Analyst
description:
### **Description**

About the role:  
  
We have an excellent opportunity to join our newly established IT Service Desk Team, supporting internal colleagues at Aurora, a highly successful energy analytics consultancy. This is an office-based position located in our Gurugram office, working shifts as part of the Service Desk Team to provide **24x5 rotational global support**.

To succeed in this role, you’ll need minimum of 5 years of global technical support hands on experience, delivering solutions across diverse IT environments and ensuring high customer satisfaction. Key technologies include **Windows 11, Microsoft 365, MS Teams, Intune, account administration tools (e.g., Entra, SharePoint), and general hardware/software troubleshooting.**

We’re looking for someone who is resourceful, adaptable, and **an excellent communicator (essential for this role)** who can quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues while working effectively with colleagues across multiple teams and global locations.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Triage and categories IT Support tickets (Incidents, Service Request, etc.) responding to and resolving tickets within SLA

* Strong customer service ethos; proactive and team-oriented mindset
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are a must
* Ability to build strong working relationships at all levels
* Flexible, positive attitude with a willingness to take on new challenges
* Self-starter with strong problem-solving and time-management abilities
* Ability to prioritise and handle multiple tickets effectively

**Technical skills (Required):**

* **Microsoft Office 365 administration** and application support
* **Windows 11 setup**, configuration and troubleshooting

* Hands-on experience resolving **hardware-related issues**
* Familiarity with **cloud VPNs and basic networking concepts**
* Experience with **Azure Entra ID, Intune, Defender, and Microsoft Endpoint Manager**
* Microsoft Teams support and administration

**Desirable attributes:**

* ITIL certification or familiarity with the ITIL framework
* Awareness of GDPR and ISO 27001 compliance
* Microsoft or other IT support certifications

  

### **What we offer**

Some of the benefits we include are:

* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.

To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.  
  
Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

### **About Aurora Energy Research**

From its academic roots, Aurora Energy Research is a thriving, rapidly growing company, currently serving over 1000 of the world’s most influential energy sector participants, including utilities, investors, and governments.  
  
While we constantly strive to reach new markets and diversify our product portfolio, we are already active across the globe in Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Europe, South Africa and North America, working with leading organisations to provide comprehensive market intelligence, bespoke analytic and advisory services, and cutting-edge software.  
  
We are a diverse team of experts with vast energy, financial, and consulting backgrounds, covering power, hydrogen, carbon, and fossil commodities. With this, we provide data-driven intelligence to fuel strategic decisions in the global energy transformation.

title: Procurement Specialist (IT)
description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.

Ankura is a global expert services and advisory firm that helps organizations protect, create, and recover value at critical inflection points. Guided by its mission, Driving Excellence, Delivered with Humanity™, Ankura brings together multidisciplinary expertise, collaborative problem solving, and practical technology-enabled solutions to support clients across conflict, crisis, performance, risk, strategy, and transformation.

**Location:** Gurgaon (Remote)

**Timings:** US Shift (6 PM - 3 AM IST)

**Role Overview:**

The Procurement Senior Associate, Ankura IT, supports the end-to-end procurement lifecycle for technology goods and services across the firm. This role partners closely with IT, Finance, Legal, Accounts Payable, business stakeholders, and external suppliers to execute sourcing activities, manage purchase orders, support supplier onboarding, maintain procurement records, and help ensure purchasing activity is cost-effective, compliant, and aligned with Ankura’s operational needs.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, service-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced professional services environment. This position requires strong follow-through, attention to detail, stakeholder communication, and the ability to improve procurement processes where structure may still be evolving.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Partner with IT stakeholders to understand purchasing needs, validate requirements, and support sourcing strategies for hardware, software, SaaS subscriptions, professional services, maintenance agreements, and related technology services.
* Support competitive sourcing events, including RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs, by coordinating vendor outreach, collecting responses, preparing comparison summaries, and supporting supplier recommendations.
* Create, process, and track purchase requisitions and purchase orders, ensuring alignment with approved budgets, vendor quotes, procurement policies, and approval workflows.
* Support supplier onboarding, vendor record maintenance, catalog updates, and data accuracy within Coupa or other procurement systems.
* Coordinate with Accounts Payable to resolve invoice, receipt, purchase order, and payment discrepancies in a timely and professional manner.
* Assist with contract administration by tracking renewals, key milestones, pricing terms, service commitments, and required stakeholder reviews.
* Monitor supplier performance, order status, delivery timelines, and service issues; escalate risks, delays, or compliance concerns as appropriate.
* Analyze spend, purchasing trends, vendor utilization, and renewal activity to identify opportunities for cost savings, standardization, consolidation, and process improvement.
* Maintain clear procurement documentation to support audit readiness, compliance, reporting, and institutional knowledge.
* Advise internal teams on procurement processes, vendor engagement expectations, purchasing timelines, and best practices.
* Assist with system testing, workflow improvements, reporting enhancements, and process documentation to improve procurement efficiency and visibility.
* Perform other procurement, vendor management, reporting, or IT operations support activities as assigned.

**Requirements:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
* 5+ years of experience in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, supply chain, vendor management, or a related operations role.
* Experience supporting technology procurement, including hardware, software licensing, SaaS, maintenance renewals, managed services, or IT professional services.
* Experience executing RFx activities, vendor comparisons, purchase orders, supplier onboarding, and procurement documentation.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret spend data, compare vendor options, and present clear recommendations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work professionally with executives, business stakeholders, vendors, Finance, Legal, and Accounts Payable.
* High attention to detail, strong organization, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with competing deadlines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
* Experience with procurement or ERP systems; Coupa experience preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience in a global, multi-location, consulting, professional services, or high-growth organization.
* Experience with IT asset lifecycle processes, software renewals, vendor consolidation, contract tracking, and license management.
* Knowledge of procurement controls, audit readiness, approval workflows, supplier risk, and contract compliance.
* Familiarity with Service Desk Plus, asset management platforms, or IT operations workflows.
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup formulas, data validation, and spend analysis.
* CPSM, CSCP, ITIL Foundation, or similar procurement, supply chain, or IT operations certification preferred.

**Work Environment & Schedule:**

  

* Remote or hybrid work arrangement based on team structure and business needs.
* Normal business hours aligned US time zones, with flexibility required to support stakeholders across multiple regions.
* Occasional after-hours support may be needed for urgent business, supplier, renewal, or operational requirements.
* Light travel may be required for team meetings, vendor discussions, office support, or business initiatives.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **Ownership:** Procurement requests are tracked, documented, followed through, and completed with minimal rework or escalation.
* **Service Partnership:** IT stakeholders, Finance, Legal, Accounts Payable, and vendors receive timely, clear, and professional communication.
* **Cost and Value:** Sourcing activities support measurable savings, vendor standardization, spend visibility, and improved purchasing discipline.
* **Compliance and Audit Readiness:** Purchase records, approvals, supplier documentation, contracts, and renewal details are accurate, complete, and easy to validate.
* **Continuous Improvement:** The role identifies process gaps, recommends practical improvements, and helps mature Ankura IT procurement operations.



Ankura is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability. Equal Employment Opportunity Posters, if you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation to search for a job opening, submit an online application, or participate in an interview/assessment, please email accommodations@ankura.com or call toll-free +1.312-583-2122. title: Infra Tech Support Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** Infra Tech Support Practitioner  

**Project Role Description :** Provide L1–L2 technical support for infrastructure, systems, and applications in production and development environments, both remotely and onsite, following defined operating models and processes. Act as the primary interface with users/clients to accurately diagnose issues and deliver effective resolutions across infrastructure, operating systems, networks, and application platforms, ensuring service stability and quality support.
  

**Must have skills :** Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure DevOps  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As an Infra Tech Support Practitioner, a typical day involves delivering first and second level technical assistance for infrastructure, systems, and applications across both production and development settings. This role requires working closely with users and clients to identify and resolve issues efficiently, ensuring smooth operation and stability of services. The position includes providing support through remote and onsite engagements, adhering to established procedures and operational frameworks to maintain high\-quality service delivery and minimize downtime.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* AKS Cluster Provisioning and Configuration: Deploy and set up AKS clusters with appropriate configurations using Terraform and Azure DevOps.

  

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues related to Kubernetes, AKS clusters and related components like Istio, GitOps, Autoscaling, Helm, Kustomize etc. Need to troubleshoot issues related to Terraform during AKS Cluster deployment.
  

  

Upgrades and Patches: Plan and perform AKS upgrades and apply security patches to keep the clusters up\-to\-date and secure.
  

  

ITSM: Need to work on incidents, Change Requests, RCAs, CMDB etc.
  

  

Documentation: Need to create documentation related to AKS.
  

  

Shifts and On\-call: Need to work on night shifts and on\-calls on a rotational basis, as and when required by the team.
  

  

Meetings and Calls: Need to participate in various calls and discussions with different teams as AKS SME and to share required inputs as Kubernetes / AKS SME.  

  

  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure DevOps.


Kubernetes : In\-depth knowledge of Kubernetes concepts, architecture, and administration.
  

  

Should have in\-depth knowledge on core Kubernetes concepts like Pods, Deployments, Services, Namespaces, PVs, PVCs, Storage Classes, Role Assignments, Kubernetes Networking, PDBs, HPA etc. Need to have proficiency on working with kubectl tool. Need to have good knowledge and understanding on YAML files related to Kubernetes.
  

  

AKS : Should have in\-depth knowledge on AKS concepts like Node Pools, AKS RBAC, AKS upgradation, Node OS upgradation, AKS Monitoring, AKS Logging, Workload Identity etc.
  

  

Azure DevOps: Working knowledge of Azure DevOps , which includes Azure Repo, branching strategy, pull requests, and git commands. Must know how to use Azure DevOps through IDE tool like VS Code.
  

  

Azure : Proficiency in using Azure services, especially Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  

  

Should have good knowledge on Azure Services like VNet, Subnet, UDR, NSG, Private Endpoint, Private DNS, Managed Identity, Role Assignment, Key Vault, Storage Account , Load Balancer etc.
  

  

Terraform: Should have experience in using terraform to deploy Azure Services and AKS Cluster.
  

  

AKS Cluster Provisioning and Configuration: Deploy and set up AKS clusters with appropriate configurations using Terraform.
  

  

Monitoring and Logging: Should have good knowledge on monitoring and logging solutions to gain insights into cluster performance, application behavior, and resource usage.
  

  

Security: Should have good knowledge on security best practices for AKS, including RBAC (Role\-Based Access Control), network policies, and secure container images.
  

  

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues related to AKS clusters, Kubernetes, Terraform, and infrastructure components.
  

  

Upgrades and Patches: Plan and perform AKS upgrades and apply security patches to keep the clusters up\-to\-date and secure, using in\-line or blue\-green upgradation approach.
  

  

GitOps : Working knowledge of any of the GitOps tool (Flux / ArgoCD) is preferred.
  

  

Service Mesh : Knowledge of a Service Mesh product (ex: Istio) is preferred.
  

  

Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to diagnose and resolve issues related to Kubernetes and containerized applications.
  

  

Cloud Native Ecosystem: Awareness of other cloud\-native tools and technologies such as Istio, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

Communication and Teamwork: Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
  

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Kubernetes.
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.
